The issuer shows weak liquidity (current ratio of 0.83), and extremely high leverage with liabilities at ~93% of total assets, which increases financial risk and reduces balance-sheet resilience in a downturn. While profitability appears solid (EBIT/operating income of 5,855 on revenue of 30,125), the leverage and liquidity combination supports a speculative-grade rating rather than investment grade.

DECISION: BB-
